purpose: Defines the local-first SQLite persistence layer, WAL concurrency mode, database migrations, connection pooling, repository APIs, and typed read models for Lumen session intelligence.
scope: Covers crates/lumen-store: SqliteStore, MigrationManager, QueueRepository, SessionRepository, ToolCallRepository, CommandEventRepository, FindingsRepository, RollupRepository, and typed read models.
non_goals: Hook process interception or daemon async scheduling (handled by lumen-daemon).
Log file parsing or stream transformation (handled by lumen-session).
Direct network I/O or remote cloud sync.

api_surface.name: SqliteStore
api_surface.signature: pub struct SqliteStore { pool: r2d2::Pool<r2d2_sqlite::SqliteConnectionManager>, is_read_only: bool }; impl SqliteStore { pub fn open(path: &Utf8Path) -> Result<Self, StoreError>; pub fn open_read_only(path: &Utf8Path) -> Result<Self, StoreError>; pub fn run_migrations(&self) -> Result<usize, StoreError>; pub fn connection(&self) -> Result<r2d2::PooledConnection<r2d2_sqlite::SqliteConnectionManager>, StoreError>; }
api_surface.description: Connection pool manager configuring SQLite in WAL mode with PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON and query_only flags for concurrent multi-reader access.
error_conditions: StoreError::MigrationFailed if forward schema migration encounters SQL error
StoreError::ReadOnlyViolation if write query is attempted on read-only pool

api_surface.name: QueueRepository
api_surface.signature: pub struct QueueRepository<'a> { conn: &'a rusqlite::Connection }; impl<'a> QueueRepository<'a> { pub fn enqueue(&self, provider: &str, session_id: &str, source_path: &str, source_hash: u64) -> Result<i64, StoreError>; pub fn fetch_pending(&self, limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<QueuedSessionRow>, StoreError>; pub fn mark_completed(&self, id: i64) -> Result<(), StoreError>; pub fn mark_failed(&self, id: i64, error: &str) -> Result<(), StoreError>; }
api_surface.description: Repository managing the ingestion_queue table with exponential retry scheduling and dead-letter classification after 3 failures.

api_surface.name: SessionRepository
api_surface.signature: pub struct SessionRepository<'a> { conn: &'a rusqlite::Connection }; impl<'a> SessionRepository<'a> { pub fn upsert_session(&self, record: &SessionFactRecord) -> Result<(), StoreError>; pub fn get_session(&self, id: &str) -> Result<Option<SessionDetailReadModel>, StoreError>; pub fn list_recent(&self, filter: &SessionFilter) -> Result<Vec<SessionSummaryReadModel>, StoreError>; }
api_surface.description: Repository for normalized session facts, supporting idempotent upserts keyed on (provider, provider_session_id) and typed read models.

api_surface.name: FindingsRepository
api_surface.signature: pub struct FindingsRepository<'a> { conn: &'a rusqlite::Connection }; impl<'a> FindingsRepository<'a> { pub fn insert_findings(&self, session_id: &str, findings: &[FindingFactRecord]) -> Result<(), StoreError>; pub fn list_top_findings(&self, limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<FindingReadModel>, StoreError>; }
api_surface.description: Repository storing structured findings with confidence scores, evidence JSON payloads, and rule versions.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WHEN SqliteStore opens a database file, THE SYSTEM SHALL configure PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL and PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON.
WHEN open_read_only is called, THE SYSTEM SHALL configure PRAGMA query_only = ON and disallow any INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE operations.

WHEN migrations are executed on a fresh database, THE SYSTEM SHALL apply all migrations from V1 to V5 and create ingestion_queue, session_snapshots, pipeline_runs, sessions, tool_calls, command_events, token_usage, session_category_scores, findings, rollups, and discovered_categories tables.
WHEN upsert_session is called multiple times with identical (provider, provider_session_id), THE SYSTEM SHALL perform an idempotent update without creating duplicate rows.
WHEN mark_failed is invoked on an ingestion queue item whose retry_count reaches 3, THE SYSTEM SHALL transition its status to 'dead_letter' and record the last error string.
IF a database migration script fails during execution, THE SYSTEM SHALL roll back the transaction and return StoreError::MigrationFailed without modifying database state.
WHEN list_recent is executed with limit = 50, THE SYSTEM SHALL return typed SessionSummaryReadModel structs in under 2 milliseconds.
WHEN command events are inserted, THE SYSTEM SHALL store command_base and redacted argument patterns, ensuring zero raw private arguments are persisted.
WHEN serializing read models to JSON, THE SYSTEM SHALL produce byte-identical JSON matching the Mac app and CLI read contracts with BTreeMap ordering.
IF a database is locked by a concurrent reader, THE SYSTEM SHALL retry with busy_timeout = 5000ms before returning an error.

reasoning: Establishes the durable, local-first SQLite WAL storage engine, migration manager, repository boundaries, and typed read models.
